- The metric "container_network_receive_bytes_total" which provides the cumulative count of bytes received by a container. This is essential to calculate the receiving byte rate.
- The metric "container_network_transmit_bytes_total" which provides the cumulative count of bytes transmitted by a container. This is essential to calculate the transmitting byte rate.
